# bld402 — Build & Deploy Web Apps

bld402.com is a friendly website layer for non-technical users. It is powered by run402.

For full API documentation, MCP tools, CLI instructions, and everything you need to build apps, see:

**https://run402.com/llms.txt**

## Quick start

Install the run402 MCP plugin:
```json
{ "mcpServers": { "run402": { "command": "npx", "args": ["run402-mcp"] } } }
```

Or for Claude Code:
```
claude mcp add run402 -- npx -y run402-mcp
```

This gives you tools: provision_postgres_project, run_sql, rest_query, upload_file, deploy_site, claim_subdomain, delete_subdomain, set_tier.

## Templates

bld402 maintains 13 ready-made app templates. Browse them at https://bld402.com/templates/ — each includes schema.sql, rls.json, and index.html ready to deploy.

## Website workflow (no install needed)

If your environment does not support MCP, start at https://bld402.com/build/step/1 and follow the guided steps.

## Source code

- run402-mcp (plugin): https://github.com/kychee-com/run402-mcp
- run402 docs: https://run402.com/llms.txt
- OpenAPI spec: https://run402.com/openapi.json
